description:
Companion to explorer-read-model-18-translator-version in BenchBox-dev/benchbox-site (AGENTS.md: the site and Explorer app live there; change them there by PR). The build-contract check throws on any read-model mismatch (explorer-build-contract.mjs ~:38 and ~:42; pin at ~:5); db.ts ~:206-215 already only warns on newer versions (pin at ~:48). Per the bump procedure (ADR site-repo-split D16), the site must accept BOTH 17 and 18 before core switches its default. Add a 'SQL translator' row in the run receipt (RunReceipt.tsx ~:210-211) showing the version and whether it was recorded by the run or attested afterwards (with explanatory text for 'attested'), 'not recorded' when absent, and nothing or 'not applicable' for DataFrame runs. Check whether '^container' variant ids from #3618/#3630 already render and route correctly; do not duplicate that work.

GUARDRAILS: follow the site repo's own AGENTS/CONTRIBUTING, branch, review and merge rules (read them first); no production deploy without owner approval; keep the change to contract tolerance, the query and the receipt row.
